summary: LookupFieldValue also probes ALL-UPPERCASE field names so typed store columns populate from Priority's uppercase OData fields.
reason: Generated store template only probes snake/camel/Pascal; Priority (and other ERP OData APIs) return IVNUM/CUSTNAME-style uppercase keys, leaving typed columns NULL and breaking aging/debtors/reconcile.
